{{Top|leg}}
The '''Department of Environmental Maintenance''' was a division of the [[Tallaani Shipyards]] which was responsible for maintaining the [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems of the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Kijo Mnuue]] was the director of the department.
